claims.content: To obtain updated surveillance data by initiating a J7.1 message.

goal.raw_text: To obtain updated surveillance data by initiating a J7.1 message.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages on the Link 16 network.
Surveillance information is available in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
The C2 JU has originated surveillance amplification data or holds relevant track, engagement, platform/system status, or EW evaluation data for a specific TN.
Receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN.

trigger.raw_text: Receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN.

claims.content: The requesting JU initiates the J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) message with the specific TN in the Reference TN field and addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal.

Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU that have originated surveillance amplification data on the track shall respond with the J6.0 Amplification message containing all available data.

Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU controlling the TN shall transmit the appropriate J10 Weapons Coordination and Management messages and J13 Platform and System Status messages to include the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message, the J10.2 Engagement Status message, and the appropriate J13 Platform and System Status messages.

All C2 JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN shall transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.
If the Reference TN is being reported in a J3.7 message, the reporting JU shall transmit all data held in a J3.7 message.

Also, if the request is collectively addressed, any JU which has initiated an EW evaluation or association on the Reference TN in a J14.2 message shall transmit a J14.2 message with EW Action Value field set to values 7, 8, or 9 addressed to the requesting unit with the R/C field set to value 1.

If the request is specifically addressed, the addressee shall transmit all locally held EW evaluations and associations in the J14.2 message with EW Action Value field until local operator action is taken to reenable the JU to accept and originate exercise tracks.

If the request is collectively addressed, any JU which has initiated an EW evaluation or association on the Reference TN in a J14.2 message shall transmit a J14.2 message with EW Action Value field set to values 7, 8, or 9 addressed to the requesting unit with the R/C field set to value 1.

If the request is specifically addressed, the addressee shall transmit all locally held EW evaluations and associations in the J14.2 message with EW Action Value field until local operator action is taken to reenable the JU to accept and originate exercise tracks.

If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture. If J2 messages are not received subsequent to this action and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.

If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated. After decorrelation, the C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.
The requesting JU receives the J6.0 Amplification message containing all available surveillance data from the originating JU.
The requesting JU receives appropriate J10 Weapons Coordination and Management messages, including the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message and J10.2 Engagement Status message.
The requesting JU receives J13 Platform and System Status messages from the controlling JU.
All C2 JUs receiving the request have transmitted J10.2 Engagement Status messages reporting the status of all engagements they are conducting.
All C2 JUs receiving the request have transmitted a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.
If the Reference TN was reported in a J3.7 message, the requesting JU has received all data held in a J3.7 message from the reporting JU.

If the request was collectively addressed and EW evaluations/associations existed, the requesting JU has received J14.2 messages with EW Action Value field set to values 7, 8, or 9 and R/C field set to value 1.
If the request was specifically addressed, the addressee JU has transmitted all locally held EW evaluations and associations in the J14.2 message with appropriate EW Action Value field settings.
